scope: Cross-experiment synthesis of complete Source-1 population measurements from F003a and X008; no sampling. New raw rerun attempted but execution surfaces failed before user code.

production_semantics.d: first normalized address number + production address word
production_semantics.h: first six characters of space-stripped normalized name + first address number
production_semantics.z: first six characters of space-stripped normalized name + last address number
production_semantics.cutoff: country-local target posting frequency <=1000 in production; values below are Source-1 proxy DF

caveats: F003a number-only coverage uses the best DF among any distinct address numeric run, whereas production d: uses the first address number. This makes the number-only comparator more permissive, so the d: selectivity rescue is conservative but not an identical-key ablation.
X008 and F003a are Source-1 collision/selectivity proxies; production posting frequencies come from pooled S2/S3 target inventory.
France has no labels; no accuracy, recall, precision, or F0.5 claim is made.

The newly proposed number+full-name-token family was not empirically rescanned in this session because both local Python surfaces and the container failed with session-level ClientError before user code execution.
next_gate: On the full target inventory, ablate existing d/h/z channels and test whether number+full-name-token or multi-number composites recover additional positives at fixed cap.
